in_marathi.name: Shefali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shefali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shefali means 'Goddess of Wealth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shri' which is an epithet of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity.
